premises.text: Making even small web-page changes requires calling a developer or agency, paying hundreds or thousands, and waiting days or weeks, while non-coders are stuck with rigid paint-by-numbers templates
premises.evidence_span: if you wanted to make even the slightest change to a page on the Web, like moving something one inch to the right, you better be willing to call a developer or agency, pay hundreds or thousands, and wait days or weeks

premises.text: PageCloud lets anyone with a browser edit pages with PowerPoint-like freedom—drag widgets, embed YouTube/Eventbrite URLs, manipulate objects—and changes go live immediately on save
premises.evidence_span: If you know how to use PowerPoint or Keynote or Photoshop, you already know how to use PageCloud

premises.text: Mobile mode lets users reflow content so pages look good on phones without wrestling complex mobile web tech
premises.evidence_span: Page Cloud dramatically simplifies the incredibly complex task of making Web pages mobile-friendly

premises.text: Copy-page analyzes an existing site, breaks it into root content, and rebuilds it as a pixel-accurate PageCloud-editable page (patent-pending)
premises.evidence_span: PageCloud will analyze everything that's going on on this page, break it down into its root content and rebuild it in PageCloud editable format

premises.text: Preorder pricing with a Disrupt promo is $75 for the year for a site
premises.evidence_span: you're going to get an amazing price of just $75 for the year for your site
